name: Hardware Ray Tracing Global Illumination
definition: One-bounce diffuse global illumination using hardware RT cores. It cosine-samples the hemisphere around a surface normal, traces short RT rays, and gathers indirect irradiance from hits (sun term * albedo) or skylight if rays escape.
summary: Hardware Ray Tracing Global Illumination approximates one-bounce diffuse global illumination using hardware RT cores to trace rays against voxel bricks, differing from cone-based methods by using explicit ray queries and from precomputed lighting by computing results per-frame.
